title: Lord Draxinusom
summary_html: Lord Draxinusom [drax-in-oo-som] is the leader of the gargoyles in Britannia, known by the title of "Grand Inquisitor" among his race. Initially encountered as an adversary during the wars of Ultima VI, the Gargish ruler eventually became a stalwart friend of the Britannian people after the "sacrifice" enacted by the Avatar to bring peace between his people and the subjects of Lord British.
